_comment: The module-backed base image, and the `DeferredBody` record it answers in. FOUR TRIALS RETIRED 2026-09-17 with the code they mutated: the mount prefix dropped, an archive with no declared mount prefix accepted, every member filed under the first archive, and the seal envelope read as the descriptor itself. All four described a reconstruction this reader no longer performs -- it opened an archive's descriptor to recover a mount prefix, and grouped members to fill a list, for a record that was immediately reduced back to an address, its mirrors and a length. Nothing downstream read either field. A trial for deleted code cannot fail, and keeping it as an always-ROTTED spec teaches people to ignore `--validate`.
verify: cd host && npx vitest run test/module-base-image.test.ts >/dev/null 2>&1
